FaqPage.Splitify is a simple tool to divide expe: Splitify is a simple tool to divide expenses and bills equally among friends and group members.
FaqPage.You input the participants and their pay: You input the participants and their payments, and Splitify will calculate and suggest the best way to split the expenses.
FaqPage.Do I need to create an account?: Do I need to create an account?
FaqPage.No, Splitify works without the need to c: No, Splitify works without the need to create an account or sign in. You can start using it immediately.
FaqPage.Yes, Splitify is completely free to use: Yes, Splitify is completely free to use. There are no hidden fees or premium features.
FaqPage.Does Splitify optimize the number of nec: Does Splitify optimize the number of necessary transfers?
FaqPage.Yes, Splitify uses an algorithm to minim: Yes, Splitify uses an algorithm to minimize the number of transfers needed, making the payment process faster and more efficient.
FaqPage.Can I create a collaborative group with: Can I create a collaborative group with my friends?
FaqPage.Yes, you can easily create a group, add: Yes, you can easily create a group, add your friends, and start splitting expenses together. It's perfect for shared dinners, trips, and more!
FaqPage.Can I add details to each expense?: Can I add details to each expense?
FaqPage.Yes, you can add more details such as th: Yes, you can add more details such as the expense date, description, and even categorize the expense for better tracking.
